name: Serpentbloom
summary: Deep in the Wailing Caverns, Serpentbloom draws Apothecary Zamah’s attention. She seeks more specimens for the Royal Apothecary Society’s research and the Forsaken.

sections.title: Eyes of the Apothecary
sections.body: Apothecary Zamah watches the Pools of Vision beneath Thunder Bluff’s Spirit Rise. She came from the Undercity as an envoy of the Royal Apothecary Society. Her tauren hosts tend to spiritual balance and the wounded land, while Zamah studies rare and virulent materials. She has isolated a sample of Serpentbloom and seeks more for Lady Sylvanas Windrunner and the Forsaken’s research.

sections.title: The Depths of the Caverns
sections.body: Serpentbloom grows in the damp, twisting grottos of the Wailing Caverns, far from the Barrens’ open sun. The corrupted druids of the Fang have twisted these humid depths, where serpentine denizens guard the plant. Many scouts sent by Zamah failed to return. Now she seeks hardy adventurers to gather more.

faq.answer: Apothecary Zamah is a researcher and envoy of the Royal Apothecary Society from the Undercity. She watches the Pools of Vision beneath Thunder Bluff’s Spirit Rise and links Forsaken alchemists with the wider continent of Kalimdor.

faq.q: Why does the Royal Apothecary Society want Serpentbloom?
faq.answer: Zamah believes Serpentbloom holds chemical potential when refined in large quantities. The Society seeks rare, potent plants across Kalimdor to aid the Forsaken’s alchemical experiments.
Serpentbloom grows in damp caverns beneath the northern Barrens, within the Wailing Caverns’ rock corridors and passages.

The Wailing Caverns are overrun by devolved beasts, raptors, and the corrupted Druids of the Fang. Inexperienced foragers were quickly overwhelmed by predators and venomous defenders in the winding tunnels.

faq.q: Do the Tauren approve of Zamah's research?
faq.answer: The tauren of Thunder Bluff gave the Forsaken sanctuary out of sympathy and a desire to heal them. The Royal Apothecary Society’s alchemy can approach unnatural experimentation, troubling traditional shamans and druids.

faq.q: Does harvesting Serpentbloom require herbalism skills?
faq.answer: No. Any adventurer willing to brave the Wailing Caverns can pluck Serpentbloom from the cave floor without herbalism training.

angles.text: Gathering Serpentbloom supports the Royal Apothecary Society’s alchemical work in Lordaeron, under the Dark Lady’s mandate.
As a tauren, you see Horde hospitality in the welcome given Forsaken apothecaries beneath the Spirit Rise. Their lethal concoctions contrast with traditional earth healing.
The twisted Wailing Caverns nurture flora found nowhere else on the Barrens’ sunbaked surface.
This work strengthens the early alliance between the Undercity and the Kalimdor tribes. They share resources and rare reagents across the ocean.
